gate_assessments.evidence: Signed approved project evidence covers required bounded local actions under secure noncommercial nonsharing aggregate-only citation and time constraints.

The immutable DOI snapshot identity and a redacted live observation are bound and grouping is complete at the table level, but exact selected bytes, final canonical manifest and live-to-snapshot byte equivalence are incomplete.
gate_assessments.bounded_correction: Resolve exact selected remote bytes content-blindly and complete the restricted canonical manifest, linkage and checksum receipts without claiming equivalence unless a complete comparison succeeds.

gate_assessments.evidence: Synthetic local decode preflight passed, but no selected ChildLens video or audio was processed and no human timing coverage was measured.
gate_assessments.bounded_correction: Run the frozen selective pilot and apply the 80 percent decode and 70 percent manually corrected boundary thresholds.

gate_assessments.evidence: Actual language, corrected transcript and timing quality, and five-way role reliability remain unmeasured.
gate_assessments.bounded_correction: Use qualified language-matched humans on the first 300 utterances or 30 speech minutes and require role macro-F1 of at least 0.80 with blinded reference and bounded corrected text error.

gate_assessments.evidence: No fully human-dispositioned non-child transcript recurrence audit was run.
gate_assessments.bounded_correction: Require at least 8 noun/object and 6 verb/action candidates meeting every frozen cross-participant train visible-link and held-out support rule.

gate_assessments.evidence: The packet and ontology are frozen but no genuine human visible null ambiguity or lag judgments were collected.
gate_assessments.bounded_correction: Double-code at least 20 percent, retain all null and ambiguous cases, require at least 15 percent visible-candidate coverage and nominal status alpha or equivalent of at least 0.67.

gate_assessments.evidence: Participant and session grouping can support deterministic splits, but release-specific lexical/action support after splitting is unmeasured.
gate_assessments.bounded_correction: Freeze participant-disjoint and session-disjoint split manifests before lexical inspection and establish frozen support in at least 3 held-out participant groups.

gate_assessments.evidence: The construction protocol is frozen, but release-specific timing/referential target reliability and paired canonical manifest equality are not established.
gate_assessments.bounded_correction: Validate the strong-target annotations and prove equal RGB/text inventory exposure with only the named alignment transformation; do not train either control in the feasibility task.

gate_assessments.evidence: The permission receipt supports nonidentifying ChildLens video/audio aggregates; absent physical modalities remain explicitly unavailable and simulator-defined only.

The low storage envelope passes, two CPU workers are admitted and metadata-quarantine owner indexing and backup controls were established, but exact selected media bytes, human labor and later compute remain unresolved.
gate_assessments.bounded_correction: Revalidate quarantine and selective shards under the 20 GiB raw cap, 73 GiB peak namespace cap and 50 GiB post-peak free-space floor, then measure annotation labor.

decision_basis.summary: Permissions and immutable public identity are resolved sufficiently for a bounded local pilot, and a content-blind 15-item preselection is frozen. Exact selected bytes and final manifest, media pilot evidence and genuine human language timing role referential validation remain; therefore GO is unsupported and STOP is unwarranted.
